main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move in the short direction

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 confirms; mean < 0 with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of the short unusual move on |forecast|

decided_by: the mean unusual move is positive with t >= 2 and the slope on forecast size is above 0
reading: a case is a short bet as the workflow defines it (a rise of the short forecast of at least 2 points from its lowest level since the last bet, every bar being a 1-bar grid cell), forecast size is |forecast|, the day-clustered standard error uses a G/(G-1) correction, the 30-day minimum maps to 'not observable', and the situation check uses the rise condition and short side only since the profile components are not recorded

direction_check.why: main measure +0.003237 on the check folds against +0.005299 on every fold
